changelog:
xiaozhi-teach-math-lesson-planner 2.0.0 — Major version update with restructured documentation and new reference templates.

- Reorganized SKILL.md, providing clearer structure and added cross-references to sample templates for concept建构, 例题示范, 变式训练, and 错例档案.
- Added four comprehensive sample files under references/: concept-build-sample.md, error-case-file-sample.md, example-demo-sample.md, and variation-training-sample.md to guide standardized lesson planning.
- Updated documentation to promote the use of modular samples and ensure consistent workflow for math concept teaching.
- Removed lite and summary files (SKILL.lite.md, skill-card.md) for simplified maintenance and to direct users to detailed reference samples.
- Enhanced privacy/compliance guidelines and expanded collaboration and API usage descriptions.
